title: Blacksmith Hits $1B Valuation with $66M Series C Led by Sequoia
summary:
More than 10,000 companies now use the Blacksmith platform to run their builds and tests, totaling over 90 million jobs per week. The AI code-testing startup raised $66M in a Series C round led by Sequoia that valued the firm at $1B. This valuation grew from $550M in August when the company closed a $45M Series B round.

Launched in 2024 as part of Y Combinator's W24 batch, Blacksmith provides cloud infrastructure designed to accelerate continuous integration (CI). The company's founders stated that while the writing of code is no longer the slowest part of software shipping, the process of validating that code has become the primary bottleneck.
